title: Eagles claim Cowboys draft pick off waivers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles claim Cowboys draft pick off waivers
sources.description: The Philadelphia Eagles claimed Ajani Cornelius off waivers from the Dallas Cowboys, according to an official team announcement. Cornelius, 24, is a 6-5, 318 pound offensive lineman who was selected with a sixth-round pick (No. 204 overall) in the 2025 NFL Draft. Playing college football for Rhode Island and Oregon, Cornelius almost exclusively played at […]
